purpose: Reproducible NLU evaluation, not model fine-tuning
notes: Temporal slot equivalence is evaluated through the production DateResolver
Unexpected non-null slots reduce overall slot accuracy
critical_slots define the extraction fields that must be correct for the scenario
Delete is supported as soft-delete only after explicit confirmation in the business layer
The live runner records raw provider outputs, schema retries and latency
